name: Haydon's shed

objects.text: A ring light. It's on. It's always on.
Three monitors, a mic on an arm and a clip-on mic for good measure. Plaqueboymax is on one of them.
His gaming chair. Still warm. Smells like ragebait.
A list. Every name is scribbled out. Under it, in Haydon's writing: [REDACTED].
Snacks. A sticky note: "nah these aren't yours". They're yours.
